北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京今天多云，体感 12℃。注意添衣，别着凉啦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy, feels like 12℃. Stay warm and don't catch a cold!
北京.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪下雨 12℃，体感 9℃。雨天湿滑，出门记得带伞。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is rainy 12℃, feels like 9℃. Take an umbrella and be careful of wet roads.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海有雨，气温 12℃。湿答答的，出门记得带伞，小心路滑。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has rain, 12℃. Don't forget your umbrella, be careful of slippery roads.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天 22℃，体感暖和，湿度大。记得多喝水哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is overcast 22℃. It feels warm and humid, stay hydrated!
广州.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降7℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳 25℃ 阴天，湿度高，体感舒适。记得多喝水哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is overcast 25℃, high humidity. Stay hydrated!
深圳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州小雨 13℃，体感 11℃。出门备伞，别着凉，路上慢行。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has light rain 13℃, feels like 11℃. Bring an umbrella and keep warm.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有雾 14℃，体感 12℃。能见度低，开车出门注意安全。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has fog 14℃, feels like 12℃. Low visibility, drive safely.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都 21℃ 晴朗，体感 19℃。阳光正好，出门散步很舒服！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny 21℃, feels like 19℃. Perfect for a stroll outside!
成都.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾 17℃，能见度低。驾车出行请减速慢行，注意安全。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has fog 17℃. Low visibility, please drive slowly and safely.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安 21℃ 晴天，体感 19℃。阳光明媚，记得多补充水分。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny 21℃, feels like 19℃. Enjoy the sunshine, stay hydrated!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆 20℃ 晴朗，体感 19℃，阳光灿烂，心情也会棒棒哒！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is sunny 20℃, feels like 19℃. Bright sunshine, have a great day!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨 9℃，体感只有 5℃。风大天冷，出门一定多穿点！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is 9℃, feels like 5℃. It's windy and cold, dress warmly!
哈尔滨.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳 10℃ 多云，体感 11℃。昼夜温差大，别忘了添衣哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is 10℃ cloudy, feels like 11℃. Mind the temperature difference!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明 21℃ 多云，体感 17℃。风力稍大，出门注意防风保暖。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is 21℃ cloudy, feels like 17℃. It's breezy, stay warm!
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门 23℃ 阴天，体感 21℃，湿度高。风力稍大，很舒服。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is 23℃ overcast, feels like 21℃. High humidity, a bit breezy.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天 11℃，体感 7℃。风力不小，出门记得多加件衣服。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is overcast 11℃, feels like 7℃. It's breezy, wear an extra layer.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天 12℃，体感 8℃。温差大，早晚注意添衣保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is overcast 12℃, feels like 8℃. Mind the temperature changes.
